# Target settings

<!-- Generated by `osb docs -o docs/reference`. Do not edit. -->

Target-specific settings are set under `artifacts.<target>` in the configuration.
All of them are optional, and every value may use `${{ }}` expressions, for
example to tag images per flavor. How the targets work is described in
[Targets](../targets.md).

```yaml
artifacts:
  oci:
    tags: ["devbox:${{ flavor.name }}"]
  qcow2:
    disk-size: 20G
```

| Target | Settings |
|---|---|
| [`shell`](#shell) | `colors` |
| [`dockerfile`](#dockerfile) | `base-image`, `env`, `labels`, `user`, `workdir`, `expose`, `volumes`, `entrypoint`, `cmd` |
| [`oci`](#oci) | `tags`, `builder`, `platform`, `archive`, `push` |
| [`wsl`](#wsl) | `name`, `default-user`, `systemd`, `hostname` |
| [`cloud-init`](#cloud-init) | `hostname`, `extra` |
| [`qcow2`](#qcow2) | `base-image`, `sha256`, `disk-size`, `memory`, `cpus`, `driver`, `libvirt-uri`, `timeout`, `compress` |
| [`ova`](#ova) | `name`, `memory`, `cpus`, `os-type` |

## shell

The generated POSIX shell script: `osb render shell`, `osb apply` and the run script inside cloud-init.

| Setting | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `colors` | bool | `false` | Color the messages (steps, warnings, errors) when the script runs in a terminal. Without it, the script contains no terminal handling at all. |

## dockerfile

The self-contained Dockerfile: `osb render dockerfile`, and the base of `oci` and `wsl`.

| Setting | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `base-image` | string | the flavor's image: `ubuntu:24.04`, `debian:13`, `archlinux:latest` | Image for `FROM`. It must belong to the flavor's distribution family. |
| `env` | map | – | Environment variables, written as `ENV` right after `FROM`: available to all steps and in the running container. |
| `labels` | map | – | Additional `LABEL`s. osb always sets `org.opencontainers.image.title` (the configuration's `name`) and `org.opencontainers.image.description`. |
| `user` | string | – | `USER` at the end of the file: the user the container runs as. All steps run as root before it. |
| `workdir` | string | – | `WORKDIR` at the end of the file: the working directory of the container. |
| `expose` | list | – | Ports for `EXPOSE`, e.g. `[80, 443/tcp, 53/udp]`. Documentation only: publish them with `docker run -p`. |
| `volumes` | list | – | Paths for `VOLUME`, e.g. `[/data]`. |
| `entrypoint` | list or string | – | `ENTRYPOINT`: a list is written in exec form (`["/usr/bin/tini", "--"]`), a string in shell form. |
| `cmd` | list or string | `["/bin/bash"]` when neither `cmd` nor `entrypoint` is set | `CMD`: a list is written in exec form, a string in shell form. |

## oci

`osb build oci`: builds the Dockerfile into a container image. `builder` and `platform` are also used by `wsl`.

| Setting | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tags` | list or string | `<name>:<flavor>` | Image names, e.g. `["registry.example.com/devbox:${{ flavor.name }}", devbox:latest]`. |
| `builder` | string | `docker` | Container CLI that builds (and saves and pushes) the image. docker needs BuildKit, the default since Docker 23. One of: `docker`, `podman`. |
| `platform` | string | – | Build for another platform, e.g. `linux/arm64` (`--platform`). Building for a foreign architecture needs QEMU emulation (binfmt). |
| `archive` | string | – | Additionally save the image to this tar file (`docker save`). A relative path is relative to the output directory. |
| `push` | bool | `false` | Push all tags after the build. Log in to the registry first (`docker login`). |

## wsl

`osb build wsl`: builds the image like `oci`, adds the WSL configuration and exports `<name>-<flavor>.wsl`.

| Setting | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | the configuration's `name` | Distribution name that `wsl --install --from-file` suggests (`[oobe] defaultName` in `/etc/wsl-distribution.conf`). |
| `default-user` | string | root | User that WSL logs in as (`[user] default` in `/etc/wsl.conf`). Create the user with `add-user`. |
| `systemd` | bool | `true` | Boot the distribution with systemd (`[boot] systemd`), so services run. systemd is installed when the image does not have it. |
| `hostname` | string | the Windows computer name | Host name of the distribution (`[network] hostname`). |

The image is built with `artifacts.oci.builder` and `artifacts.oci.platform`.

## cloud-init

The `#cloud-config` user-data: `osb render cloud-init`, and the configuration of the `qcow2` and `ova` build VMs.

| Setting | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `hostname` | string | – | Host name, set with cloud-init's `hostname` module. A `set-hostname` step takes precedence. |
| `extra` | map | – | cloud-config merged into the generated user-data: new keys are added, lists are appended to osb's lists (for example `runcmd` entries run after osb's), and other values replace osb's. |

## qcow2

`osb build qcow2`: boots a cloud image with the configuration as cloud-init and saves the disk as `<name>-<flavor>.qcow2`. `ova` builds with these settings, too.

| Setting | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `base-image` | string | the flavor's official cloud image (Ubuntu 24.04, Debian 13 genericcloud, Arch Linux cloudimg) | URL or path of a cloud image with cloud-init; a relative path is relative to the configuration. Downloads are cached for 7 days in `~/.cache/osb/images`. |
| `sha256` | string | – | Expected SHA-256 checksum of the base image; the build fails on a mismatch. |
| `disk-size` | string | `10G` | Virtual size of the disk (`qemu-img` sizes: `512M`, `20G`). The cloud image grows its root file system to it on boot. |
| `memory` | int | `2048` | Memory of the build VM in MiB. |
| `cpus` | int | `2` | Number of CPUs of the build VM. |
| `driver` | string | `qemu` | `qemu` runs `qemu-system-x86_64` directly (with KVM when `/dev/kvm` is usable); `libvirt` creates a transient domain with `virsh`. One of: `qemu`, `libvirt`. |
| `libvirt-uri` | string | `qemu:///session` | libvirt connection for `driver: libvirt`, e.g. `qemu:///system`. |
| `timeout` | string | `30m` | Maximum duration of the build VM run, e.g. `90s`, `45m`, `1h30m`. |
| `compress` | bool | `true` | Compress the image (`qemu-img convert -c`): a smaller file, slightly slower first reads. |

## ova

`osb build ova`: builds the `qcow2` image (with `artifacts.qcow2`) and packages it as `<name>-<flavor>.ova` for VMware and VirtualBox.

| Setting | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | `<name>-<flavor>` | Name of the virtual machine in the OVF descriptor. |
| `memory` | int | `2048` | Memory of the virtual machine in MiB, written to the OVF (the build VM uses `artifacts.qcow2.memory`). |
| `cpus` | int | `2` | Number of CPUs of the virtual machine, written to the OVF. |
| `os-type` | string | per flavor: `ubuntu64Guest`, `debian11_64Guest`, `other5xLinux64Guest` | VMware guest OS identifier; VirtualBox maps it to its own OS type. |
